description: Interaction contract shared by odd-button and its product implementations.

cases.title: Attributes convert to properties; boolean and enum state reflects
The control is a native button and the default slot names it
Click, Enter, and Space each dispatch one click at the host
Focusing the host focuses the control
Disabled ignores activation and is not focusable
Loading ignores activation but stays focusable and exposes aria-disabled
type="submit" submits its form once, including name and value
A cancelled click does not submit
Reconnecting neither leaks owned work nor duplicates activation
Programmatic property changes dispatch no user-intent events
A theme-value change keeps the control node and applies
